disposition_reason: 32 composite retail samples (16 noodle, 16 pasta) of four brands from Sulaimani markets were analysed by ICP-OES after microwave digestion for Pb, As, Cd, Ni and Cr; Table 1 prints one mean (n=3) per sample.

study.market: local markets across Sulaimani (Sulaymaniyah), Kurdistan Region, Iraq
study.method: ground, closed-vessel microwave digestion with HNO3/H2O2 at 210 C, ICP-OES
study.qa: spike recoveries 97-103%; procedural blanks; calibration r > 0.999; no CRM reported

unresolved: Table 1 does not say which of the 32 sample numbers are noodles and which are pasta, or which brand each belongs to, so all are labelled 'noodles or pasta'.
Arsenic and chromium are total values.
Sample collection dates are not reported.
Cd for sample 28 is printed as 0.00 mg/kg, below the stated LOD.
Whether instant-noodle seasoning was included is not stated; Figure 1 shows dried noodle and pasta products.
The text gives the arsenic minimum as 0.05 mg/kg (sample 26), but Table 1 prints 0.02 mg/kg for sample 20.
